definitions.full: H8480. Tachath II. תַּ֫חַת proper name 1. masculine a. Levite 1Chr 6:9 ; 6:22 . b. Ephraimite 1Chr 7:20 (twice in verse). — Θααθ , Κααθ , etc. 2. location station in wilderness Num 33:26-27 , Κατααθ . חָדְשִׁי תַּחְתִּים see II. קָדֵשׁ 2 תִּיכוֺן see תָּוֶךְ
